facts.fact: The Auditor General's report on the 2025 accounts audits the PMEC civil-service payroll as a running SAP system, finding workflow controls on only 8 of 29 infotypes, an unsupported Oracle database and no interface with IFMIS, with findings stated as at 31 August 2026.

ZMB.note: Document only lists ASYCUDA World among revenue audit paragraphs; states nothing on its status or use.
